lines.text: 小周把伞递给他：“给，它昨天在我家住了一晚。”
lines.py: Xiǎo Zhōu bǎ sǎn dì gěi tā: “gěi, tā zuó tiān zài wǒ jiā zhù le yì wǎn.”
lines.en: Xiao Zhou hands it to him. "Here you are. It spent last night at my place."
